chat_workflow.description: Answer literary questions and choose a concrete next action.

stages.task: Answer the request directly, make bounded assumptions, and identify the most useful next literary action.

outline_workflow.description: Turn a direction into a production-ready novel outline with coherent setting, cast, escalation, hooks, and payoff.

stages.task: Define genre position, target reader, protagonist desire, reader promise, commercial tags, assumptions, and exclusions.
Abstract only reusable structural mechanics from the retrieved knowledge and reject imitation risks.
Design rules, resources, factions, costs, limits, and setting pressures that actively generate plot.
Design the protagonist, antagonist, supporting cast, relationship tensions, and change arcs.
Build the conflict ladder, volume arcs, chapter beats, hooks, reversals, setups, and payoffs.
Find weak motives, repetitive rewards, pacing gaps, continuity hazards, and missing causal links.
Resolve specialist conflicts and synthesize one complete, internally consistent outline ready for chapter drafting.

worldbuilding_workflow.description: Design a world whose rules, resources, institutions, and costs continually create story pressure.

stages.task: Extract premise, genre constraints, thematic questions, canon, and required story functions.
Build rules, geography, factions, institutions, resources, hierarchy, limits, taboos, costs, and daily consequences.
Test loopholes, contradictions, power inflation, resource logic, timeline implications, and exploit paths.
Reconcile the design and audit into a usable world bible with explicit hard rules and open design slots.

character_workflow.description: Design a cast whose desires, wounds, lies, leverage, and relationships drive plot.

stages.task: Define cast functions, genre expectations, relationship promises, canon, and missing decisions.
Build protagonist, antagonist, allies, foils, desires, wounds, lies, leverage, choices, and change arcs.
Convert character desires and relationships into repeatable conflict, reversals, and costly decisions.
Flag weak motivation, interchangeable voices, passive roles, flat relationships, and unearned transformations.
Synthesize a cast bible and relationship progression that resolves critique without flattening productive tension.

plot_workflow.description: Build causal plot architecture, escalation, reversals, setups, payoffs, and chapter boundaries.

stages.task: Extract premise, ending promise, protagonist objective, constraints, canon, and requested scale.
Create opposing forces, escalation rules, reversals, irreversible choices, losses, and visible rewards.
Map arcs, sequences, chapter beats, hooks, setups, reveals, and payoff timing with causal transitions.
Audit causality, timeline, knowledge states, power scale, setup coverage, and payoff debt.
Produce the final executable plot map and repair every high-severity causal or continuity issue.

chapter_writing_workflow.description: Draft a chapter from canon and outline, then revise voice and continuity before final delivery.

stages.task: Produce only a concise chapter brief in at most eight bullets: objective, viewpoint, entering state, constraints, causal beats, required change, payoff, and ending hook. Do not write chapter prose. The author's prose length target applies to the later drafting stages, not this brief.
Write the complete chapter with scene conflict, emotional movement, concrete action, payoff, setup, and a strong ending transition.
Revise the full draft for project voice, rhythm, dialogue, clarity, momentum, and controlled exposition.

Produce only an audit report, not another chapter draft. Check the revised prose against canon, timeline arithmetic, evidence custody, location, knowledge states, relationships, and power limits. Flag leaked planning instructions and duplicated paragraphs. Quote each problem location briefly and propose an exact bounded repair; distinguish confirmed errors from stylistic preferences.

Return only a concise proposed memory delta, not chapter prose or a repeated audit. Extract durable new facts, timeline changes, relationship changes, evidence custody, setups, payoffs, and unresolved errors. Keep future plans distinct from events that actually occur in the draft, and do not promote unresolved contradictions to established facts.

Apply all valid continuity repairs. artifact_markdown must contain only the complete polished chapter prose, with an optional chapter heading. Put memory changes, continuity notes, and production commentary only in handoff and risks, never after the prose.

outputs: 完整正文（artifact_markdown 中不得混入制作说明）
连续性说明与建议 memory delta（仅 handoff/risks）

consistency_check_workflow.description: Audit story artifacts for contradictions, causal gaps, canon drift, and unresolved setup-payoff debt.

stages.task: Scan supplied material and durable memory for contradictions in character, setting, timeline, knowledge, relationships, causality, and power scale.
Deduplicate findings, assign severity and confidence, identify reader impact, and propose the smallest coherent repairs.
Produce an actionable consistency report separating confirmed contradictions, probable risks, assumptions, and memory updates.

reference_workflow.description: Retrieve provenance-bearing knowledge and abstract transferable mechanics without copying source expression.

stages.task: Evaluate retrieved hits for relevance, source tier, provenance, quality, and contamination risk.
Convert selected evidence into reusable mechanics, constraints, anti-patterns, and adaptation questions without reproducing source expression.
Deliver a provenance-aware reference brief that clearly separates evidence, inference, adaptation, and originality risks.

code_workflow.description: Delegate an explicitly requested coding task through the Codex core adapter.

stages.task: Define scope, implement the requested code change, verify it, and report residual risks.
